change_summary: Choose processing cost from the unresolved semantic bottleneck so corpus-wide Work Model topology and completeness use deep reasoning before the first durable plan while bounded cohesive work stays standard or economy.

canonical_skill.note: The Workspace Skill selects economy, standard, or deep from remaining judgment and routes corpus-wide owner/topology or completeness decisions to deep without using file type or size as a classifier.

server_contract.note: The server advertises Skill release 1.7.66 and collaboration contract 2026-09-17.5, while Mission planning requires branch-level source sufficiency before a first durable topology plan.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.66; compatibility family and minimum revision remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace and Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.35; their shared server-discovered processing-profile contract remains compatible and needs no CLI protocol change.

help_center.note: Public Help remains compatible because the public Skill page projects this shared package and the release does not change remote MCP connection or installation steps.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports Skill 1.7.66 and continues to route detailed processing-profile decisions through the loaded canonical Skill.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Harness now verifies selected-Workspace routing, and the mainline records the first-plan evidence sufficiency and processing-profile boundary exposed by a fresh Codex organization run.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party publication, public hashes and fresh released-host readback remain release gates; external directory acceptance stays outside repository authority.

release_evidence.note: Backend, Mission Prompt, external-host, and frontend package-contract tests assert the new release, profile decision boundary, selected-Workspace receipt, and source-coverage sufficiency rule.
